scripts.dev: pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present build && pnpm --recursive --filter "./apps/*" --parallel run --if-present dev
scripts.build: pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present build && pnpm --recursive --filter "./apps/*" run --if-present build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present build && pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present typecheck && pnpm --recursive --filter "./apps/*" run --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present build && pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run --if-present test && pnpm --recursive --filter "./apps/*" run --if-present test
